content: publicsuffix2 (last release 2019-12-21) is effectively unmaintained. tldextract (5.3.0, latest release Dec 2025) is the actively maintained standard for registered-domain extraction via the Public Suffix List; supports fully offline operation via TLDExtract(suffix_list_urls=()) falling back to a bundled PSL snapshot with zero network calls -- required for passive-only philosophy (D-08/D-09). Default behavior fetches+caches live PSL on first use; must be explicitly disabled for a no-outbound-calls guarantee.
